name: dsh-xssh-ops
description: XSSH ops for DSH Web UI: connect to servers over SSH (terminal / SFTP / tunnels), edit commands locally, correlate every command with its output line range, and run background jobs whose results land in remote temp files. Host half manages sessions with ssh2; client half renders the terminal, the line-number view and the command ledger.

scripts.build: npm run gen:xterm-css && npm run build:host && npm run build:client
